description:
Detect context overflow in the agent loop and trigger auto-compaction,
matching pi-mono's _checkCompaction() and _runAutoCompaction().

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts lines 1761-2016.

Depends on: CompactionStart/End events, Compaction module, Loop migration to SessionManager.

## check_overflow/2

Add private function in loop.ex:
  check_overflow(assistant :: OctoPi.AI.Message.Assistant.t(), model :: OctoPi.AI.Model.t())
    :: :ok | {:overflow, :error_message | :silent}

Returns {:overflow, :error_message} if:
  assistant.stop_reason == :error AND
  assistant.error_message contains any of (case-insensitive):
    "context window", "too long", "maximum context", "prompt is too long",
    "reduce the length"

Returns {:overflow, :silent} if:
  model.context_window is a positive integer AND
  assistant.usage != nil AND
  assistant.usage.input_tokens >= model.context_window

Returns :ok otherwise.

Reference: pi-mono overflow detection lines 1761-1810.

## Wire into continue_or_stop/6

After receiving the assistant message from stream_turn/3, BEFORE appending it:

  case check_overflow(assistant, state.model) do
    {:overflow, kind} ->
      handle_overflow(session, state, session_manager, kind, abort_ref, turn)
    :ok ->
      # existing logic: append assistant, check stop_reason, etc.
  end

## handle_overflow/6

  1. Do NOT append the error assistant message to session_manager.
  2. Check state.overflow_recovery_attempted? — if true, fall through to normal
     error handling (prevents infinite compaction loops). Reference: pi-mono line 1789.
  3. Mark overflow_recovery_attempted: true via GenServer.call(session, :set_overflow_recovery_attempted).
  4. Emit CompactionStart{reason: :overflow} via Subscribers.dispatch/2.
  5. Run Compaction.compact/3 with state.session_manager and state.transport.
  6. On success: SessionManager.append_compaction -> updated sm; emit CompactionEnd{reason: :overflow, will_retry?: true, result: result}; update session_manager in Session via GenServer.cast(session, {:update_session_manager, sm}); call loop/6 again with updated sm to retry the failed turn.
  7. On error: emit CompactionEnd{reason: :overflow, aborted?: true, error_message: msg}; return {session_manager, :error}.

## Threshold-based proactive compaction

After a successful assistant message (non-overflow), also check:
  if model.context_window != nil AND
     assistant.usage.input_tokens > model.context_window * 0.85 do
    run_threshold_compaction(...)
  end

This is proactive compaction BEFORE overflow. Does NOT retry — just compact
and continue. Emits CompactionStart{reason: :threshold} / CompactionEnd.

## Session state sync during compaction

Add to session.ex:
  handle_call(:set_overflow_recovery_attempted, ...) -> sets flag, returns :ok
  handle_cast({:update_session_manager, sm}, ...) -> replaces state.session_manager

While is_compacting? is true, new prompt/2 calls should be queued:
  Add compaction_queue: [] to Session.State (default []).
  In handle_call(:prompt, ...) when is_compacting?: true, push to compaction_queue
  and return {:reply, :queued, state}.
  In handle_cast({:compaction_complete, ...}), drain compaction_queue by calling
  the prompt handler for each queued message.

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/loop_compaction_test.exs.
Use a mock transport:
  - First call: returns Assistant with stop_reason: :error and overflow error_message
  - Second call: returns normal :stop response
Verify:
  - CompactionStart{reason: :overflow} fires
  - The overflow error assistant message is NOT in the final transcript
  - CompactionEnd{will_retry?: true} fires
  - The retry succeeds and adds a normal assistant message
  - overflow_recovery_attempted? prevents a second overflow from looping infinitely
title: Overflow detection and auto-compaction in Loop
